question: Should dashboard widget gallery/install-from-URL live in the bundled dashboard plugin, in ClawHub package discovery, or wait until the Wave 1 dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The request crosses product distribution and security boundaries, and current main does not yet have the workspace/widget registry it would write to.

options.title: Defer behind Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open until the workspace registry and sandboxed widget approval substrate are merged or replaced, then design the gallery against that actual API.

options.title: Make ClawHub the gallery
options.body: Use ClawHub package search, provenance, and scan status as the discovery layer, with OpenClaw only owning a narrow dashboard install/approval bridge.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled gallery
options.body: Let the dashboard plugin own a first-party gallery and URL installer, with explicit security review for the new remote-code entry point.

recommendation.title: Defer behind Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the workspace registry and sandboxed widget approval substrate are merged or replaced, then design the gallery against that actual API.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available current-main owner for the native plugin-tab and product-boundary precedent, with adjacent ClawHub owners available for install trust details.
